primary.version: HITMAN World of Assassination with HITMAN 1 GOTY content and Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack
primary.why: This entry refers to HITMAN (2016), the first World of Assassination season, not Hitman: Codename 47. The original 2016 release covered its initial platforms, while IO Interactive now makes World of Assassination the current unified route across platforms through the 2026 patch notes. On Windows, the current WOA build gives the highest capture/settings ceiling, and the Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack fills the old PS4-only mission gap.
primary.how_to_play: Install HITMAN World of Assassination on Windows, keep the game patched, and verify that HITMAN 1 GOTY destinations/content are available. Add the Sarajevo Six Campaign Pack for every HITMAN 1-era mission, and archive with online services available because progression, challenges, contracts, and live-service features depend on IOI services.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this with Hitman: Codename 47, which is a separate 2000 game. Older standalone HITMAN 1 purchases were replaced by World of Assassination as the current storefront path in 2023. Preserve any run with clear notes about server-dependent challenges, contracts, unlocks, cross-progression, and live-service availability.

entries.definitive_edition: HITMAN World of Assassination Deluxe Edition / Deluxe Pack on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use native PC for primary. Console/mobile/cloud routes should be captured only for platform comparison; Quest 3 VR Reloaded is standalone hardware-specific software.

primary.version: HITMAN World of Assassination Deluxe Edition / Deluxe Pack, current PC build
primary.why: Windows is a launch platform for Hitman III, now also known as Hitman: World of Assassination. The current PC build has the highest capture ceiling, current WOA content hub, PC VR support, and PC-only ray tracing/adaptive-supersampling options. The Deluxe Pack/Deluxe Edition is the most complete route because it covers H3 Deluxe content, Seven Deadly Sins, and the H2 Expansion Access Pass.
primary.how_to_play: Install HITMAN World of Assassination on PC through a current storefront, then own/install the Deluxe Pack or equivalent Deluxe Edition entitlements for the extra campaign/DLC content. Stay online for progression, contracts, Freelancer/live content, and server-side features; document the build and owned DLC at capture time.

secondary.exclusive_content: HITMAN 3 VR: Reloaded is a standalone untethered VR version with dual-wielding, a new art style, overhauled VR UI, and movement/interactivity changes not represented by the flat PC primary.
secondary.what_to_play: Capture separately only if documenting the standalone VR rework; it is not the definitive route for the main World of Assassination archive.
secondary.why: XR Games and IOI released it as a new Meta Quest 3 VR version of HITMAN 3 with unique VR-specific features.

Do not treat that as meaning every DLC is included without the Deluxe Pack. Stadia is discontinued. The Switch release is cloud-based. entries.title: Hitman Absolution
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release for campaign fidelity; Feral iOS/Android/Switch as secondary for active Contracts Mode

emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the primary. Console emulation is unnecessary for the archive route; capture Feral mobile/Switch ports only for Contracts Mode or portability comparison.

primary.version: Original Windows PC release, current Steam/GOG build with owned DLC/Professional content where available
primary.why: Windows is among the original 2012 release platforms, and the PC version has the highest resolution/settings/capture ceiling. The PS4/Xbox One HD Enhanced Collection runs up to 4K/60, but it remains a console remaster of the same game; the newer iOS, Android, and Switch ports are useful for active Contracts Mode but not the main fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Windows release for the main campaign at max settings, documenting exact store/build and owned DLC. If the archive needs active Contracts Mode, capture the Feral iOS/Android/Switch version separately as a secondary route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Feral's 2026 updates restore active Contracts Mode with player-created assignments and cross-platform leaderboards on mobile and Switch.
secondary.what_to_play: After the PC campaign capture, use the Feral mobile or Switch version only if the archive needs current Contracts Mode behavior.
secondary.why: The original Absolution Contracts Mode servers were closed in 2018, while Feral's 2026 releases/updates explicitly add active Contracts support for mobile and Switch.

all_releases.fidelity: Original native PC version with highest settings/capture ceiling and current Steam/GOG availability.
all_releases.reason: Windows releases exist from 2012 onward, including Steam and later GOG. PC version differences and fixes are well known, making Windows the best archive route for the campaign.

all_releases.fidelity: HD Enhanced Collection remaster, up to 4K/60 on supported hardware.
all_releases.reason: The HD Enhanced Collection includes Hitman: Absolution on Xbox One, running at 4K/60. It is a good console route but not the archive primary.

all_releases.fidelity: Feral mobile port with touch controls plus gamepad/keyboard-and-mouse support and active Contracts Mode after the 2026 update.
all_releases.reason: Feral released Absolution on iOS in 2025 and added Contracts Mode on May 14, 2026. It is secondary because current Contracts Mode is missing from the PC primary.

all_releases.fidelity: Feral mobile port with touch controls plus gamepad/keyboard-and-mouse support and active Contracts Mode after the 2026 update.
all_releases.reason: Feral released Absolution on Android in 2025 and added Contracts Mode on May 14, 2026. It is secondary for active Contracts capture, not primary campaign fidelity.

all_releases.fidelity: Feral Switch port with active Contracts Mode after the June 2026 free update; below PC for raw fidelity.
all_releases.reason: Feral released Absolution on Nintendo Switch on November 13, 2025 and added Contracts Mode on June 9, 2026. It has Switch 2 compatibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is best for campaign fidelity and capture. The Feral mobile/Switch ports are lower-fidelity routes but currently preserve active Contracts Mode, which the original PC/PS3/Xbox 360 online service lost after the 2018 shutdown.

entries.remaster_caveats: HD Enhanced Collection on PS4/Xbox One is a 4K/60 remaster bundle with Blood Money, not a complete replacement for the PC route. Feral's mobile/Switch ports add modern controls and revived Contracts Mode, but they are separate lower-fidelity portability routes. Native Switch 2 support was announced as a 2026 free upgrade for Switch owners, but sources available on 2026-06-14 describe it as forthcoming rather than a released platform.

entries.title: Hitman Blood Money L.A.
entries.definitive_edition: Original J2ME mobile build, preferably the highest-resolution preserved version

emulation.notes: Use a Java ME emulator with the preserved game file and match the intended screen resolution when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original J2ME behavior, limited by preserved handset build

primary.version: Original Java mobile release by Morpheme/Eidos
primary.why: L.A. is a standalone Java/mobile follow-up to Blood Money Vegas, with no console or PC release. The only authentic platform is legacy mobile/J2ME; modern play is preservation through a compatible Java ME emulator.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally preserved `.jar`/`.jad` build on original compatible mobile hardware, FreeJ2ME, MicroEmulator, KEmulator, or J2ME Loader. Record the exact resolution build because J2ME games often shipped in multiple handset-specific variants.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 2D/isometric Java mobile game, resolution/build dependent.
all_releases.reason: L.A. is a mobile-phone game by Morpheme/Eidos. No other release platform exists.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original handset builds are the most authentic but hard to source and device-specific. Emulator capture is practical and likely higher quality, but must document the exact mobile build/resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is not the 2006 PC/console Blood Money and not Blood Money Vegas; it is a separate Java mobile title. Metadata is sparse and no public release references page was found, so confidence is medium despite multiple real sources.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this 2004 game, sometimes informally called Hitman 3, with HITMAN 3 (2021). Contracts remakes/revisits some Codename 47 material but is its own entry and not a substitute for the 2000 original. Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered was announced in June 2026 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S in 2027, but it is not a released platform route as of 2026-06-14.

entries.title: Hitman Sniper The Shadows

emulation.notes: Android emulation can only help inspect preserved client files; it does not restore the official live service. iOS archival footage/device capture is the cleaner documentation route.

primary.version: Final iOS live build, archival only
primary.why: The game released only on iPhone/iOS and Android. The game was delisted and shut down in January 2023, so the iPhone row is an archival reference pick rather than a currently playable recommendation; Android is equivalent content but not more complete.
primary.how_to_play: There is no current official way to play after the January 4, 2023 shutdown. For archival coverage, use preserved iOS footage or a pre-shutdown device/account capture if available; otherwise document the shutdown rather than replaying it through unofficial server claims.

all_releases.fidelity: Original iOS mobile release; no longer officially playable after the service shutdown.
all_releases.reason: Primary: archival reference route among two equivalent mobile releases; chosen only to provide one documented capture target because the live game is shut down.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Android mobile release; likewise no longer officially playable after the service shutdown.
all_releases.reason: Skip: same release content as iOS and no sourced exclusive content; Android may be useful only if a preserved APK/device is needed for research.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The issue is preservation rather than port content: both mobile versions are equivalent, but the complete live game is no longer officially accessible after delisting and shutdown.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted from App Store/Google Play on December 1, 2022 and shut down on January 4, 2023; do not treat current third-party APK listings as an official play route.
